comment: Turns the newsletter subscription feature on or off.
modal: Controls whether newsletter functionality is available, including the storefront subscription form. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether visitors without an account can subscribe to the newsletter.
modal: When **Yes**, guests who are not registered customers can sign up for the newsletter; when **No**, only registered customers can subscribe. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether subscribers must confirm via an email link (double opt-in) before being subscribed.
modal: When **Yes**, newsletter sign-ups use double opt-in: a confirmation email is sent and the subscription becomes active only once the link is clicked. Can be set per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the newsletter confirmation email is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity for the subscription confirmation (double opt-in) email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the newsletter subscription-success email is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity for the email confirming a successful newsletter subscription — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities. Can differ per store view.

comment: Which store email identity the newsletter unsubscribe email is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity for the email sent when a customer unsubscribes from the newsletter — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities. Can differ per store view.
